text:
Jules Park: dropping a quick review thread for the routing editor compact pass. Goals: make reorders readable, ensure undo/snapshot semantics are clear, and tighten accessibility for low-vision / color-blind users. proto: https://figma.com/file/unique-snap

Rohan Mehra: nice work. first nit: undo history is confusing. users expect an immediate 'Undo' after a reorder but our current diff flow requires opening the snapshot inspector. propose an ephemeral toast with 'Undo' for 7s after any reorder, and also log the change to the snapshot timeline.

Elena Voss: love the toast idea. also we should show a small inline crumb on the rule indicating it was 'moved' with a subtle highlight for 3s so keyboard + screen-reader users can find it. aria-live announcement: "Moved 'US mobile' to position 2". keep polite.

Theo Martins: motion/performance note: live preview recalcs are noisy on low-bandwidth. add a network-aware throttle: 150ms on LAN, 400ms on slow networks. show a tiny recalculating state with a neutral gray pulse so it's less visually jarring.

Maya Liu: color accessibility: besides contrast, color-blind users confuse amber/green heatmap. propose pattern overlays on the heatmap (stripes/dots) and a color-blind legend toggle. also provide text deltas ("+12 matches") so color isn't the only cue.

A11yGuard: automated check: keyboard reorder missing a11y semantics. recommended pattern: Space/Enter to grab, Arrow keys to move, Enter/Space to drop, Escape to cancel. aria-live sequence examples: "Picked up rule 'EU desktop'", then "Moved to position 4". ensure focus returns to the rule after drop and the toast has role="status" for screen readers.

Jules Park: decisions so far: 1) show ephemeral 7s undo toast on reorder + persist change to snapshot timeline, 2) inline moved crumb highlight with aria-live announcement, 3) network-aware throttle for preview with configurable thresholds, 4) add pattern overlays and color-blind toggle for heatmap + textual deltas, 5) implement keyboard reorder semantics + focus management. I'll update the figma and add to routing-editor epic.

Rohan Mehra: UX follow-up: undo semantics edge-case: if user performs multiple rapid reorders, toast should show "Undo last" and snapshot timeline should reflect each step. keep ability to revert to any prior snapshot via inspector.

Elena Voss: copy for the undo toast: "Reorder applied. Undo" — short. For the moved crumb tooltip: "Moved 2 positions".

Theo Martins: I'll add the network-throttle detection and the small neutral pulse state to the preview component. note: for slow networks, we should also dim the preview to reduce perceived flicker.

Maya Liu: I'll design the pattern overlays (diagonal stripes for amber, dots for green) and the legend toggle. also will include a small accessibility note in the component docs.

A11yGuard: final checklist: announce moves via aria-live, ensure toast role/status, provide non-color cues for heatmap, restore focus after drop, and expose an accessible way to revert (keyboard + screen reader) to previous snapshots.

Jules Park: thanks everyone. timeline: target next sprint. please create issues for: undo-toast, moved-crumb, network-throttle, heatmap-patterns, keyboard-reorder, and tag me. I'll post the updated figma link when done. :rocket:
